record.question: The following are true of the passage, except
options: Heroin is derived from a plant
the life of an addict revolves around the drug
record.direction: Directions (Questions 88–90): Read the following passage carefully and choose the best answer. Passage: Narcotics are drugs that increase relaxation and relieve pain and anxiety. Morphine and heroin are derived from the poppy seed pod. Morphine is used medically to control severe pain; heroin is illegal in the United States. Heroin users experience a rush followed by well-being and then anxiety and cravings; larger doses are needed for the same effect. This cycle creates dependence and the addict’s life revolves around heroin. Methadone can reduce psychological cravings, but it does not cure dependence: it replaces heroin dependence with physiological dependence on methadone.
